reviewer: Neon Owner Coordinator (taking over Goose V0.2 closeout & showcase delivery)
one_sentence_end_purpose: Present the cold-verified Goose V0.2 assembly_finish_005 digital hardware closeout through four cohesive MicroDuck-inspired studio colorways, a 50/50 sagittal half-cutaway hero showing real internal 005 mechanics, and an information-dense 4K PhD/ICRA overview poster on the Sai_Rotbots homepage and Goose V0.2 page.

base_exterior_glb.note: Outer silhouette is geometry-identical to assembly_finish_005 because opt_b2_r2 is internal and body016_front received zero outer/inner cuts.

form.evidence: Horizontal mango torso, expressive long-neck/head/whole beak, and 310 mm widened side-mounted legs read as one coherent Goose V0.2 character across all four studio colorways and both cutaway hero views.

continuity.evidence: Primary shell surfaces remain clean and uninterrupted; the bespoke Rolls-Royce-inspired twin torso coachline wraps continuously across body016_front and body_continuous_rear with tapered ends; sagittal Y=0 cutaway rim is cleanly highlighted at 2.2 mm wall section.

subtraction.evidence: Removed over-decorated colored knee/ankle/neck/head caps from v2 back to neutral shell-grey / matte-black per user restraint review, and removed 7 detached cutaway cover fasteners (right_hp_shell_* and head_negative_compression_sleeve) that floated in midair in the initial cutaway pass.

coverage.evidence: Showcase studio renders present the 3/4 front-oblique hero and elevated hip-bay macro views. Rear, inboard, underside, and dynamic motion clearances were independently verified in the assembly_finish_005 CAD/FEA/closed-loop receipts (a1_architecture_decision.json, a2_a3_verification_receipt.json, yoke_outer_lip_relief_receipt.json, sanyo24_closeout_receipt.json); physical multi-angle hardware photography remains deferred to Step 2.

truth.evidence: Every presentation explicitly labels native CAD assembly_finish_005 Cycles renders (not physical photos), links exact verified receipts and SHA-256 hashes, fixes the Card 1 poster metric row separation, discloses that 41 OEM electronic keepout envelopes on P1/P2/U2D2/precharge/L1 are procedurally display-detailed strictly within their exact CAD bounding boxes (display-only, zero physics/CAD change), and declares Step-2 deferred physical bench scope.

function.evidence: All four colorway finishes and torso coachlines are purely exterior surface shaders; zero modification to frozen 21-body MCI (18.767646 kg), 43-collider SaiLab contact contract, zero-cut body016_front wall (2.12-2.27 mm), or K1/K2/cassette clearances.
